recall.uz: «Harakatda barakat» rivoyatini tinglab oʻqiymiz va oʻz hissangni qoʻshish nima ekanini bilib olamiz.
recall.ru: Слушаем предание «В действии — благо» и узнаём, что значит вносить свой вклад.
recall.en: We read the legend “Blessing is in action” and learn what it means to do your part.

props.title: Harakatda barakat
lines: Jonivorlarning bir qismi suv tashib, olovni oʻchirmoqchi boʻlibdi.
Boshqalari esa chetda tomosha qilib turibdi.
«Shu suv bilan olovni oʻchiraman deb oʻylaysanmi?»
«Bilaman, oʻchira olmayman. Lekin qaysi tomonda ekanimni bilaman.»

prompt.ru: Послушай и читай, следя за текстом!
prompt.en: Listen and follow along as you read!

hint.en: Why did the ant carry water?

explanation.uz: Rivoyat kichik boʻlsa ham, oʻz hissangni qoʻshish haqida.
explanation.ru: Предание о том, что даже малым делом нужно вносить свой вклад.
explanation.en: The legend is about doing your part, however small.

prompt.en: Sort the events into part 1 and part 2!

hint.ru: 2-я часть — о разговоре муравья и вороны.

explanation.uz: 1-qism — yongʻin va jonivorlar; 2-qism — chumoli bilan qargʻa.
explanation.ru: 1-я — пожар и звери; 2-я — муравей и ворона.
explanation.en: Part 1 — the fire and the animals; part 2 — the ant and the crow.

text.en: Will you put out the fire with that water?

text.uz: Bilaman, oʻchira olmayman, lekin qaysi tomondaligimni bilaman.
text.ru: Знаю, не потушу, но знаю, на чьей я стороне.
text.en: I know I can't, but I know which side I'm on.

clue.ru: Чьи это слова — вороны или муравья?
clue.en: Whose line is it — the crow's or the ant's?

explanation.uz: Qargʻa kuldi; chumoli esa yordam berishga harakat qildi.
explanation.en: The crow laughed; the ant tried to help.

statement.en: The ant tried to put out the fire.

why.uz: Chumoli hovuchida suv tashib, yordam bermoqchi boʻldi.
why.ru: Муравей носил воду в лапках, чтобы помочь.
why.en: The ant carried water in its palm to help.

explanation.uz: Toʻgʻri: chumoli suv tashib harakat qildi.
explanation.ru: Верно: муравей носил воду и действовал.
explanation.en: True: the ant carried water and acted.

why.en: The crow did not help, it only laughed.

explanation.ru: Неверно: ворона не помогала, а смеялась.
explanation.en: False: the crow laughed instead of helping.

lines.en: hauls a load heavier than a grain.

prompt.en: Solve the riddle: which creature is it?

hint.en: The little hero of the legend.

explanation.uz: Javob — chumoli: kichkina, ammo juda mehnatkash.
explanation.ru: Ответ — муравей: маленький, но очень трудолюбивый.
explanation.en: The answer is an ant: tiny but very hardworking.

choices.uz: Har kim yaxshilik uchun oʻz hissasini qoʻshishi kerak
choices.ru: Каждый должен внести свой вклад в доброе дело
choices.en: Everyone should do their part for good
It is better to watch from the side

prompt.en: What lesson do we take from the legend?

explanation.uz: Har kim, kichik boʻlsa ham, yaxshilik uchun harakat qilishi kerak.
explanation.ru: Каждый, пусть и малый, должен действовать ради добра.
explanation.en: Everyone, however small, should act for good.

openEnd.uz: Sen chumolining oʻrnida boʻlsang, nima qilarding? Nega?
openEnd.ru: Что бы ты сделал на месте муравья? Почему?
openEnd.en: What would you do in the ant's place? Why?

prompt.en: Match each word to its meaning!

explanation.uz: chumoli = qumursqa; hovuch = kaft ichi; rivoyat = ibratli hikoya.
explanation.ru: chumoli = муравей; hovuch = пригоршня; rivoyat = поучительный рассказ.
explanation.en: chumoli = ant; hovuch = a cupped palm; rivoyat = an instructive tale.

prompt.en: Complete the proverb with the words!

explanation.uz: «Harakatda barakat bor» — harakat qilgan natijaga erishadi.
explanation.ru: «В действии — благо»: кто действует, тот и достигает.
explanation.en: “Blessing is in action” — who acts, achieves.

clue.en: The hardworking hero of the legend

prompt.en: Build the word from the syllables!

explanation.uz: chu-mo-li → chumoli. Kichik, ammo mehnatkash jonivor.
